turns.text: So, I would change these two things, definitely.
turns.zh: 所以，这两点我肯定会改。

turns.text: And do you plan to live there for a long time?
turns.zh: 那你打算在那儿长住吗？

turns.text: No, our plan is to stay there for until the end of the year and then we'll move to a different place.
turns.zh: 不，我们打算住到年底，然后搬到另一个地方。
现在，我们来聊聊动物吧。
